correctness.rationale: For n≥2,s≥2, 0≤u≤1 including 0^0 convention, Fourier characters of (Z/sZ)^n with j nontrivial coordinates yield eigenvalues λ_{n,s,j}=Σ_{a,b} C(n−j,a)C(j,b)(s−1)^a(−1)^b u^{(a+b)²}, multiplicity C(n,j)(s−1)^j, and top sector B_n. Inductively B_n(1/n)>0, B_n(1/(n−1))<0 for n≥3, derivative negative on [0,rho_{n−1}], so unique rho_n in bracket and strictly decreasing. For j<n and u≤rho_n, grouped H_{j,0}=B_j>0 and for a≥1 H_{j,a}≥u^{a²}(2−(1+u³)^j)>0; n2 handled separately. Therefore only top sector vanishes at rho_n and nullity is (s−1)^n. For rho_n<u≤rho_{n−1}, B_n<0; for larger u<1, a binary (n−1)-subcube is indefinite by induction; u=1 is rank-one and u=0 identity. Independently evaluated root brackets n=2..15, monotone roots and all Fourier signs at sampled s=2,3,5; rho_2≈0.543689013, rho_15≈0.066806098. Finite checks corroborate, not establish, the all-dimensional induction.
